data.long_meaning: Armalda is derived from the Old German name Hermann, which means 'soldier, warrior'. The 'a' suffix is often used in Germanic names to denote femininity, so Armalda can be interpreted as 'strong woman, hidden power'. The name Armalda carries the meaning “Strong woman, hidden power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Armalda usually hope their child will grow to embody strong woman, hidden power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
